page_title: CRY 1-2 MNU | Crystal Palace v Manchester Utd 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Casemiro (Manchester United) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+1' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Bryan Mbeumo is replaced by Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United).
90+1' That's the end of the game for Amad Diallo, who is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Crystal Palace are ruled offside.
85' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) replacing Tyrick Mitchell.
85' Daichi Kamada will be replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
85' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
83' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.
83' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) replaces Luke Shaw.

82' Mason Mount (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' 3:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
81' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
78' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Yeremy Pino will be replaced by Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adam Wharton walks off the pitch to be replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).

77' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Dean Henderson has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
76' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
75' What was Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
72' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
71' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
70' Casemiro (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
68' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
66' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
65' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.

63' 1 - 2 Bruno Fernandes passes to Mason Mount (Manchester United), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:2.
63' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
62' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Robert Jones stops the game and makes a call.
61' Good play from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
59' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

58' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Leny Yoro and he is replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
54' 1 - 1 Bruno Fernandes floats a lovely ball in from the free kick. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) gathers the ball and strikes it into the bottom right corner, increasing the score to 1:1.
53' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
53' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
52' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' Casemiro (Manchester United) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom right corner from distance, but Dean Henderson hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45+4' Mason Mount (Manchester United) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
45+3' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
45+3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
45+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
45+1' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Jean-Philippe Mateta, who fails to shoot.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Casemiro (Manchester United). Robert Jones saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
42' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

40' Casemiro (Manchester United) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
38' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is substituted due to injury. Oliver Glasner gives a chance to Eddie Nketiah.
36' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Senne Lammens no chance!
35' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
33' Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) calmly steps up and smashes the ball into the bottom left corner.
33' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
32' It looks like Leny Yoro (Manchester United) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A penalty is given to Crystal Palace!

30' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
27' Dean Henderson leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).

27' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Diogo Dalot (Manchester United), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.

26' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
26' Mason Mount (Manchester United) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Amad Diallo in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.

24' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Senne Lammens pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
23' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after dangerous play.
21' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) sends a wild header high over the bar.
21' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) will take a corner kick.

21' The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick. Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
20' The corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence.

19' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
19' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

18' Good clearance! Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' A yellow card for bad language! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
15' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
13' Chance! Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Senne Lammens is alert and makes a great save to deny him.

12' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
11' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Bruno Fernandes, but pushes his close-range header well past the left post.
11' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
10' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
8' CLOSE! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

6' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
6' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
4' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
1' Casemiro (Manchester United) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Dean Henderson.

The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
